description: This file declares the AddressInfo class and related components for handling system DNS address resolution, including getaddrinfo encapsulation, iterators over addrinfo structures, and network-specific address lookups.

classes.name: net::AddressInfo
classes.description: Encapsulates system call to get address info, providing iteration, address list creation, and hostname retrieval.

classes.name: net::AddrInfoGetter
classes.description: Provides an interface for getaddrinfo calls, mainly for testing and platform abstraction.

methods.name: net::AddressInfo::Get
methods.description: Performs address resolution for a hostname with optional network context.

methods.name: net::AddressInfo::begin
methods.description: Returns iterator to start of addrinfo list.

methods.name: net::AddressInfo::end
methods.description: Returns iterator to end of addrinfo list.

methods.name: net::AddressInfo::GetCanonicalName
methods.description: Retrieves the canonical hostname if available.

methods.name: net::AddressInfo::IsAllLocalhostOfOneFamily
methods.description: Checks if all addresses are localhost of the same family.

methods.name: net::AddressInfo::CreateAddressList
methods.description: Creates an AddressList object from addrinfo data.

methods.name: net::AddrInfoGetter::getaddrinfo
methods.description: Performs getaddrinfo system call, returning addrinfo pointer.
